notes.title: [Urgent Notice] Character Selection Screen Bug After Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello,
This is the [b]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/b] development team.[/p][p]After the recent update, we have identified an issue where [b]a bug occurs on the character selection screen when using the "Resume" function[/b] for some players.[/p][p]At this time, this issue cannot be directly fixed on our side, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠 Temporary Workaround[/h2][list][*][p]If you encounter this problem, please use [b]"New Start" instead of "Resume"[/b] to play the game normally.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, [b]for players who were playing before the update, we recommend hiring your characters before applying the update[/b] to reduce the risk of this issue occurring.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We are working hard to identify the root cause and implement a proper fix as soon as possible.[/p][p]Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank all of our players for your continued support.[/p][p][b]Maru Expedition: We can fly Development Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Thank you for 10K registrations! New character teaser
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for 10K registrations! It’s been an incredible week.[/h2][p]Hello,[/p][p]We are the development team of [b]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/b].[/p][p]Since our official release, over [b]10,000 players have added the game to their Steam libraries[/b].[/p][p]With a [b]peak concurrent player count of 56[/b] and [b]over 900 unique players[/b],
we’ve received far more love and interest than we ever expected.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Thank you to players in Korea and around the world[/h2][p]Despite its short playtime, players across the globe have [b]shared gameplay videos and livestreams[/b],
and [b]many Korean streamers featured our game on their live broadcasts[/b].
Thanks to all of you, the game has reached more people than we imagined.[/p][p]We sincerely thank you.[/p][p]Our development team has truly had the best week ever.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]We’ll do our best to meet your expectations[/h2][p]To return the support and feedback you’ve given us, we’re currently working hard on the next update.[/p][list][*][p]A [b]new character[/b] is coming soon, and today we’re sharing a sneak peek at their [b]silhouette[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684091/09fb158049288544256bd47281e6b1d0cfe307ec.png"][/img][/p][p]→ [b]Feel free to leave your guesses in the comments![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Several new monster types[/b] will also be added.[/p][p]We hope these small but meaningful additions bring more fun to repeated runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on player metrics, we’re also reviewing [b]character usability and balance[/b],
and plan to implement some adjustments in a future patch.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and strive to deliver a fun and evolving gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you once again.[/p][p]— From the development team of [i]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/i][/p]

notes.title: [Launch] Maru Expedition: We can fly is officially launched!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]We’re the development team of [b]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/b].[/p][p]Starting today, you can officially play our game on Steam![/p][p]The game is based on a unique structure where you [b]catch falling characters and fight[/b], offering fun through various combinations and repeat attempts.[/p][p][/p][h2]Game Features[/h2][list][*][p]Simple controls, but diverse combat styles[/p][/*][*][p]Unique roles and attack patterns for each character[/p][/*][*][p]A structure where combinations and choices change the outcome of battle[/p][/*][*][p]A growth system designed for replayability[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Join the Community[/h2][p]We welcome your feedback on Discord![/p][p]The development team checks and reflects on your opinions directly.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/DhggjCkFDU"]https://discord.com/invite/DhggjCkFDU[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Data Collection[/h2][p]From [b]July 25[/b] for 7 days, we will be collecting gameplay data via Unity Analytics.[/p][p]For more details, please refer to the link below:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3818230/view/541111741871818514"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Gameplay Log Collection Notice (July 25 – July 31)
notes.notes:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]We are the [b]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/b] development team.[/p][p]To provide a better gameplay experience and improve game quality, we will be conducting [b]gameplay log collection via Unity Analytics[/b] as outlined below.[/p][p]🗓️ [b]Collection Period[/b]
The data will be collected for approximately [b]7 days[/b], starting from the official launch on [b]July 25, 2025[/b].[/p][p]🧭 [b]Purpose of Collection[/b][/p][list][*][p]Game balance improvement[/p][/*][*][p]Statistical analysis by character and difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Reference for refining gameplay flow and system features[/p][/*][/list][p][b]For more details on the types of data collected, please refer to the section below. Thank you![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]📜 Privacy Policy[/h1][p][b]Maru Expedition: We can fly[/b] (hereinafter referred to as “the Game”) values the privacy of users and processes personal information in accordance with applicable laws and platform policies. This policy will be presented via a consent popup upon first launch of the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]1. Types of Information Collected[/h2][h3]1-1. Information Automatically Collected via Unity Analytics[/h3][p]The Game uses Unity Analytics SDK provided by Unity Technologies to automatically collect the following information:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Account Identifier[/b]: Internal ID for identifying users via Steamworks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Device Information[/b]: Basic hardware info such as OS, screen resolution, and device model[/p][/*][*][p][b]Language & Region Info[/b]: System language settings and IP-based location[/p][/*][*][p][b]Basic Gameplay Data[/b]: Session start/end timestamps, click events, etc.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]This data is collected automatically by Unity Analytics SDK. The game developer cannot directly identify individual users using this data.[/p][/quote][h3]1-2. Custom In-Game Events Collected via Developer-Defined Logs[/h3][p]During gameplay, the following custom log events are collected based on specific in-game actions defined by the developer:[/p][p][b]1. Game Start (Run Start)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Selected ship ID, character name, difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Previous run's world and stage number[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. Stage Entry & Result[/b][/p][list][*][p]Entered world/stage number, difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Win or loss result, clear time[/p][/*][*][p]Character-based damage summary, gold collection rate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Shop Interactions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Offered characters, selected character, current difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. Character Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgraded character ID, selected upgrade ID, offered upgrades, difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][b]5. Damage Taken[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hit ship ID, enemy ID, attack type (normal/pattern)[/p][/*][*][p]World/stage/difficulty where the hit occurred[/p][/*][/list][p][b]6. Run End[/b][/p][list][*][p]Total playtime[/p][/*][*][p]Characters used, total damage and upgrades summary, difficulty level[/p][/*][/list][p]※ These logs are used solely for gameplay analysis and improvement purposes. Personally identifiable information such as names, emails, or contact details is [b]not[/b] collected.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]2. Purpose of Collection[/h2][p]Collected data is used for the following purposes only:[/p][list][*][p]Statistical analysis for game balance and character/stage improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixing and enhancing game stability[/p][/*][*][p]Incorporating player feedback into new content design[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizing user experience through analysis of game flow, difficulty, and repetition patterns[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]3. Retention and Use Period[/h2][list][*][p]All data is stored and managed through Unity Analytics servers and retained for up to [b]6 months[/b][/p][/*][*][p]After that period, the data is automatically deleted[/p][/*][*][p]All logs are stored in anonymized statistical formats, making it difficult to track or identify individual users[/p][/*][*][p]If a user does [b]not[/b] consent to data collection:[/p][list][*][p]You may refuse consent via the in-game popup at launch[/p][/*][*][p]You may delete and reinstall the game to re-trigger the consent prompt[/p][/*][*][p]Or play [b]after the collection period (July 25 – July 31, 2025)[/b] when no data will be collected[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]4. Third-Party Sharing and Delegation[/h2][list][*][p]Collected data is not shared with any third parties[/p][/*][*][p]All analysis and storage are handled via [b]Unity Analytics[/b], a service provided by Unity Technologies[/p][/*][*][p]Data is processed on Unity Technologies’ global servers[/p][/*][*][p]No additional contractors or external storage providers are used[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]5. User Rights[/h2][list][*][p]As no personally identifiable information is stored, users [b]cannot request to view, modify, or delete their data[/b][/p][/*][*][p]If you wish to withdraw your consent or stop data collection:[/p][list][*][p]Refuse data collection via the consent popup on game launch[/p][/*][*][p]Or delete and reinstall the game after the collection period ends[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]6. International Data Transfer[/h2][list][*][p]Game data is stored on [b]global cloud servers (e.g., North America)[/b] managed by Unity Analytics[/p][/*][*][p]As a result, some collected information may be transferred internationally[/p][/*][*][p]All such data is protected in accordance with Unity’s Privacy Policy[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]7. Use of Cookies and Tracking Technologies[/h2][list][*][p]This game does [b]not[/b] use browser cookies[/p][/*][*][p]However, device and session data may be collected via Unity Analytics SDK[/p][/*][*][p]This data is used strictly for [b]gameplay analysis[/b], not web tracking[/p][/*][*][p]The game does [b]not[/b] implement its own logging system; all logs are collected exclusively through Unity Analytics[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]※ Contact: [url="https://discord.com/invite/DhggjCkFDU"]https://discord.com/invite/DhggjCkFDU[/url]
※ Effective Date: July 25, 2025[/p]
